title: Disney and Adobe are building generative AI tools together
original_title: Disney and Adobe are building generative AI tools together
summary: The Walt Disney Company has teamed up with Adobe to develop proprietary "artist-led" generative AI models to support Disney's production pipeline. The multiyear partnership was announced today at Ado…
title_zh: 迪士尼与 Adobe 合作开发生成式 AI 工具
lead_zh: 华特迪士尼公司与 Adobe 达成多年合作，将开发由艺术家主导的专有生成式 AI 模型，用于支持迪士尼的内容制作流程。
